messages.subject: Re: predict in SEM
parts:
Hi

Yes. What exactly do you want to predict and with what? What is the purpose of the predictions? How to best do predictions depends on these two questions.

There are a few threads about this:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/lavaan/How$20to$20do$20predictions$20on$20lavaan$3F/lavaan/jq5wGPdxVSo/hajDF-fvwvEJ
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/lavaan/GHrjtLmaA0E/p4-eOQ1-4MAJ


The predict-function calculates factor scores, but that is not normally what people who want to do predictions want.

Mikko
